function: Jointly learns hybrid-RIS active and passive phase shifts and UAV trajectory to maximize the ISAC sum rate under statistical CSI errors, using transfer-learning DDPG (p. 2, p. 7).
system: Dual-function BS with M=4 antennas, 3 users and 3 targets with N=2 antennas each; UAV-mounted hybrid RIS, L=40 elements (La=20 active); band not stated (p. 3-4, p. 10).
method: DDPG actor-critic reinforcement learning with transfer learning: a pre-trained source agent initializes the target agent through a hybrid Q value, Eq. 30 (p. 7-8).
data_channel: Custom simulation: free-space path loss with LoS probability, Rician BS-HRIS and HRIS-target links, Gaussian-Kronecker statistical CSI errors; no 3GPP model, dataset or measurement (p. 4, p. 6).
test_conditions: Pre-training source task and new target conditions not specified; DTL said to adapt to a new domain; results vary HRIS elements, power, SCEE, CSI type (p. 8, p. 11-13).
baselines: Non-learned: AO with SCA, passive RIS, random phase, no RIS; learned: plain DDPG; DTL variants with perfect or partial CSI and without fixed beamformer (p. 10-11).
metrics: Sum rate Ru in bits/s/Hz, reward versus episodes, transmission time, target rate Rk, beampattern gain (p. 11-14).
complexity: DTL: O(ETW(tau sum lm x lm+1)); AO: O(IB U M^3 + 3 IA U L^2 N + IC U L^2); Fig. 3 plots both (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 4: "we assume free-space PL model for the communication channel between the UAV and the ground UEs"; BS-HRIS and HRIS-target links are Rician with i.i.d. Gaussian scattering (p. 4). Custom simulator; no 3GPP TR 38.901/38.811, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is used; missing.
q2_support: p. 13: "the pre-trained model adapts and optimizes faster in the new environment" (Fig. 12, DTL versus DDPG for L=30 and L=40); p. 8: "the existing Q network can be adapted by adjusting the input and output dimensions". The source task and the new test condition are never named in Section VI; reviewer to confirm.
q3_support: p. 11: "DDPG: It is used as a benchmark algorithm which is a model-free, actor-critic algorithm"; non-learned baselines are AO, passive RIS, random phase and no-RIS (p. 10-11). Plain DDPG is the proposed transfer-learning DDPG without its transfer module (p. 8); no earlier DRL method for this problem is compared; missing.
q4_support: p. 10: "of the DTL framework is given by O(ET W (τ"; the AO cost "AO algorithm is given by O(IB U M 3 + 3IA U L2 N + IC U L2 )" and Fig. 3 compare the two.
q5_support: p. 4: "we assume free-space PL model for the communication channel between the UAV and the ground UEs" (own simulated channel; parameters only in Tables III and IV, p. 10). No link to code or data and no public dataset anywhere in the paper; missing.
notes: Area 6 by the tie-break order 6 before 5 before 3: UAV-mounted hybrid-RIS ISAC link whose learned phase shifts and trajectory serve communication under sensing constraints; passes above_phy because a physical-layer decision (RIS phases) is learned jointly with the trajectory (action A = {theta, phi, iota}, p. 7). q2 borderline: transfer from a pre-trained source agent is the method (p. 8, p. 13) but the source and target settings are never specified. q3 borderline: plain DDPG is the proposed method without its transfer module (p. 8, p. 11) and the paper does not present it as an earlier published method for this problem, so it is not counted as a separate learned baseline, while the non-learned side (AO, passive RIS, random phase, no RIS) is met; the reviewer may confirm.
